summary: TD Bank filed a Form 6-K attaching legal opinions from Simpson Thacher & Bartlett and McCarthy Tétrault in connection with a takedown of $1.55B in senior medium-term notes (Series F, 4.847% fixed and floating rate due 2029) under an existing F-3 shelf registration. The filing is a routine debt issuance by a Canadian bank under its shelf program, accompanied by standard U.S. and Canadian counsel consents. No special-situation features such as a tender, restructuring, acquisition, or shareholder vote are present. This is a normal-course capital markets transaction with no event-driven implications.
